_meta.description: Frozen POB strong mappings for primary evidence. Separates on-family (primary) from in-family boundary/caveat mappings.
_meta.score_extraction: predicate_scores_all is foreground-only: score(parent) = predicate_scores_all[parent_id - 1], score(fine) = predicate_scores_all[fine_id - 1]

primary_on_family.description: On-family spatial-support predicates. These form the strongest primary claim. All 7 children entail physical support/contact on a surface.

mappings.evidence: lexical entailment (phrase-includes 'on') + visual support/contact relation + sitting posture modifier

lexical entailment (phrase-includes 'on') + visual support/contact relation; variant spelling of lying on
lexical entailment (phrase-includes 'on') + visual support/contact relation + walking action modifier
lexical entailment (phrase-includes 'on') + visual support/contact relation + parked state modifier

boundary_in_family.description: In-family containment predicate. Marked as boundary/caveat, NOT part of the strongest primary claim. covered in -> in is consistently weak across all architectures.
boundary_in_family.caveat: covered in -> in shows consistently low collapse rates (6-36% across models). This boundary case demonstrates that collapse is NOT universal across all fine-to-coarse mappings, but is specific to on-family spatial-support predicates.

excluded_from_primary.description: Extended mappings excluded from primary evidence due to medium/weak confidence or different semantic frame.
